# Pleeb Performance Panel

## [v1.8](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPerformancePanels/tree/v1.8) (2026-10-08)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPerformancePanels/compare/v1.7...v1.8) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/grimboso/PleebPerformancePanels/releases)

- Refine panel visibility and CPU sampling  
    This change centralizes panel visibility in ApplyLayout and removes redundant per-frame show/hide logic. It also tightens sampling behavior by caching recent CPU values, reducing query frequency, and avoiding rolling-window trimming outside active logging. The result is less UI churn and more stable metric updates when panels or logging are disabled.
